title: Extreme heat warning in Cherokee County
summary: A heat wave pushes the heat index above 110°F in the Upstate. NWS issues an Extreme Heat Warning. Shows heat guidance: stay cool, never leave anyone in a car, know the signs of heat stroke.

alerts.headline: EXTREME HEAT WARNING IN EFFECT FROM NOON TODAY TO 8 PM THURSDAY
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. * WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with heat index values up to 112.
* WHERE...Cherokee, Union, and York counties.
* WHEN...From noon today to 8 PM Thursday.
* IMPACTS...Extreme heat will significantly increase the potential for heat related illnesses, particularly for those working or participating in outdoor activities.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
